tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground and every surface: cards, windows, fields and tables sit on it, set apart by a frame, never by a lighter fill.

tokens.name: rd
tokens.usage: Error signal: error text, failed status, destructive actions. 8:1 on bg. Always with a word (ERR), never hue alone.

tokens.name: gr
tokens.usage: Success signal: OK badges, passing checks, live status. 12.4:1 on bg. Text on a gr fill is bg.

tokens.name: yl
tokens.usage: Warning signal: pending, degraded, caution. 14.5:1 on bg. Text on a yl fill is bg.

tokens.name: bl
tokens.usage: Focus ring (2px, 8.8:1 on bg), links in prose and info notes.

tokens.name: mg
tokens.usage: Free signal accent for editorial and media pieces: eyebrows, highlights, one per piece. 9:1 on bg.

tokens.name: og
tokens.usage: Brand accent: primary buttons, the selected tab, kickers and the ASCII bite. 8.8:1 on bg; text on an og fill is bg.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Body text and interface text on bg. 12.7:1. Muted text and control borders are fg mixed 60% into bg (5.2:1), derived in bundle.css.

tokens.name: fgplus
tokens.usage: Headings, key figures and the selected state on bg. 12.7:1.

groups.name: titles
groups.note: Jacquard24 for h1, Techno Vibe for subtitles, Sanchez for notes, TL;DR and READMEs.

styles.name: gothic-title
styles.usage: H1: the main title of every page, hero and slide. Jacquard24 runs small, so it is always the largest title on the page.

styles.name: tech-subtitle
styles.usage: Subtitles and section heads (h2, h3) under a Jacquard h1, and eyebrows in media.

styles.name: slab-title
styles.usage: Titles of notes, TL;DR blocks and READMEs. Not for blog posts or heroes.

groups.name: text
groups.note: Space Grotesk is the body and interface face. IBM Plex Serif only inside blog entries; Geist Mono only for code, terminal output and ASCII art.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Body text for everything that is not a blog entry: cards, docs, product copy, slides.

styles.name: serif
styles.usage: Blog entries only: the running text of a post, 18px/1.7 in .bl-prose.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Code, terminal output and ASCII art only. Never for labels or body text.

styles.name: doodle
styles.usage: for minimal accents that require someting doodle styled

styles.name: pen
styles.usage: for accents about something fully handmade

styles.name: oc
styles.usage: for text that simulates something hide, secret or encrypted

groups.name: ui
groups.note: Small interface text. Always Space Grotesk.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Button labels, table headers, badges, tab labels. Set in uppercase.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Hints, timestamps and helper text, in muted fg (fg 60% on bg).

spacing.note: 4px base grid. Sizes are steps, not guesses.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon gaps, inline padding, dither pitch.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks, badge padding, ASCII cell gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control padding, table cell padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and window padding, default gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between related groups.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections inside a page.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Page gutters, article header padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Hero and cover spacing.

radius.note: Brutalist: corners are square. Radius tokens exist for media overlays only.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Default for buttons, fields, cards, tables, code blocks.

tokens.name: radius-1
tokens.usage: Tiny pixel rounding, media overlays only.

tokens.name: radius-2
tokens.usage: Large media overlays only.

border.note: Line weights. Hairline 1px frames are the default; heavier only for emphasis.

tokens.name: bw-1
tokens.usage: Default frame for cards, windows, fields, tables and terminals.

tokens.name: bw-2
tokens.usage: Focus ring and heavy marks.

tokens.name: bw-4
tokens.usage: Section rules and heavy article dividers.
